alt: Imagined scene: A rocky wilderness valley opens toward green vineyards.
Imagined scene: Loose silver pieces lie beside an open sack of barley.
Imagined scene: Dry earth and withered plants border a shrinking stream.
Imagined scene: A boundary stone tilts beside disturbed earth between two fields.
Imagined scene: Rain falls on a green field as morning light breaks through mist.
Imagined scene: A clay oven glows beside dough and a partly scorched flatbread.
Imagined scene: Bare stalks bend in the wind beneath storm clouds.
Imagined scene: An empty winepress stands beside a bare threshing floor.
Imagined scene: Thorns and purple thistles grow around a stone altar.
Imagined scene: A wooden yoke lies beside fodder and loose cords.
Imagined scene: Clay oil jars and packing ropes stand beside a desert road.
Imagined scene: Wind blows dust past a dry spring and brittle grass.
Imagined scene: Dew covers lilies beside an olive tree, grain and vines.
